coverage_only_diagnostic.denominator: The same original 1,751 complete-scored off-diagonal pairs.
coverage_only_diagnostic.interpretation: Annotation-availability ranking only; neither this diagnostic nor a positive R-GCN mean AP change identifies a causal mechanism.
coverage_only_diagnostic.score: Number of original gene endpoints having at least one eligible Reactome membership through any frozen reviewed-product context mapping: 0, 1 or 2.
coverage_only_diagnostic.status: Predeclared descriptive diagnostic, not a third trained arm or primary success criterion.
coverage_only_diagnostic.ties: Retain tied scores; use unchanged scikit-learn AP/ROC-AUC definitions.
coverage_only_diagnostic.zero_means: Missing eligible membership context, not biological absence.

evaluation.missing_or_nonfinite_score: Block headline metrics; preserve failure and denominator.
evaluation.pair_score: Arithmetic mean of scores in both orientations.
evaluation.primary_contrast: rgcn_reactome minus rgcn_baseline, paired within seed
evaluation.uncertainty: Descriptive leave-one-original-gene-out influence; shared-gene pair dependence prevents an independent-pair significance interpretation.

stopping.after_fixed_result: Report every paired change and stop; no cohort, threshold, seed, model or feature sweep.
stopping.consistent_favorable_change: Internal development evidence only; independent confirmation remains necessary before external/general biological-improvement claims.
stopping.invalid_input_or_prediction: Block scientific metrics; preserve failed attempt and repair integration with synthetic controls before an explicit new receipt.
stopping.mixed_negligible_or_negative_change: Close this candidate as no demonstrated development gain.
